verses.original: Συνκαλεσάμενος δὲ τοὺς δώδεκα ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς δύναμιν καὶ ἐξουσίαν ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ δαιμόνια καὶ νόσους θεραπεύειν
verses.transliteration: Synkalesamenos de tous dōdeka edōken autois dynamin kai exousian epi panta ta daimonia kai nosous therapeuein
verses.literal: Then Jesus called the Twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons and power to cure diseases
verses.literalPt: E, CONVOCANDO os seus doze discípulos, deu-lhes virtude e poder sobre todos os demônios, para curarem enfermidades.

verses.original: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς κηρύσσειν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἰᾶσθαι τοὺς ἀσθενεῖς
verses.transliteration: kai apesteilen autous kēryssein tēn basileian tou Theou kai iasthai tous astheneis
verses.literal: And He sent them out . . . to proclaim the kingdom of God and to heal the sick
verses.literalPt: E enviou-os a pregar o reino de Deus, e a curar os enfermos.

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Μηδὲν αἴρετε εἰς τὴν ὁδόν μήτε ῥάβδον μήτε πήραν μήτε ἄρτον μήτε ἀργύριον μήτε ἀνὰ δύο χιτῶνας ἔχειν
verses.transliteration: kai eipen pros autous Mēden airete eis tēn hodon mēte rhabdon mēte pēran mēte arton mēte argyrion mēte ana dyo chitōnas echein
verses.literal: Take nothing for the journey He told them no staff no bag no bread no money no second tunic
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes: Nada leveis convosco para o caminho, nem bordões, nem alforje, nem pão, nem dinheiro; nem tenhais duas túnicas.

verses.original: καὶ εἰς ἣν ἂν οἰκίαν εἰσέλθητε ἐκεῖ μένετε καὶ ἐκεῖθεν ἐξέρχεσθε
verses.transliteration: kai eis hēn an oikian eiselthēte ekei menete kai ekeithen exerchesthe
verses.literal: Whatever . . . house you enter . . . stay there until you leave that area
verses.literalPt: E em qualquer casa em que entrardes, ficai ali, e de lá saireis.

verses.original: καὶ ὅσοι ἂν μὴ δέχωνται ὑμᾶς ἐξερχόμενοι ἀπὸ τῆς πόλεως ἐκείνης τὸν κονιορτὸν ἀπὸ τῶν ποδῶν ὑμῶν ἀποτινάσσετε εἰς μαρτύριον ἐπ’ αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: kai hosoi an mē dechōntai hymas exerchomenoi apo tēs poleōs ekeinēs ton koniorton apo tōn podōn hymōn apotinassete eis martyrion ep’ autous
verses.literal: If anyone . . . does not welcome you shake the dust off your feet when you leave . . . that town as a testimony against them
verses.literalPt: E se em qualquer cidade vos não receberem, saindo vós dali, sacudi o pó dos vossos pés, em testemunho contra eles.

verses.original: Ἐξερχόμενοι δὲ διήρχοντο κατὰ τὰς κώμας εὐαγγελιζόμενοι καὶ θεραπεύοντες πανταχοῦ
verses.transliteration: Exerchomenoi de diērchonto kata tas kōmas euangelizomenoi kai therapeuontes pantachou
verses.literal: So they set out and went from village to village preaching the gospel and healing people everywhere
verses.literalPt: E, saindo eles, percorreram todas as aldeias, anunciando o evangelho, e fazendo curas por toda a parte.

verses.original: Ἤκουσεν δὲ Ἡρῴδης ὁ τετραάρχης τὰ γινόμενα πάντα καὶ διηπόρει διὰ τὸ λέγεσθαι ὑπό τινων ὅτι Ἰωάννης ἠγέρθη ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: Ēkousen de Hērōdēs ho tetraarchēs ta ginomena panta kai diēporei dia to legesthai hypo tinōn hoti Iōannēs ēgerthē ek nekrōn
verses.literal: When Herod the tetrarch heard about all that was happening he was perplexed For some were saying that John had risen from the dead
verses.literalPt: E o tetrarca Herodes ouviu todas as coisas que por ele foram feitas, e estava em dúvida, porque diziam alguns que João ressuscitara dentre os mortos; e outros que Elias tinha aparecido;

verses.original: ὑπό τινων δὲ ὅτι Ἠλίας ἐφάνη ἄλλων δὲ ὅτι προφήτης τις τῶν ἀρχαίων ἀνέστη
verses.transliteration: hypo tinōn de hoti Ēlias ephanē allōn de hoti prophētēs tis tōn archaiōn anestē
verses.literal: others that Elijah had appeared and still others that a prophet of old had arisen
verses.literalPt: E outros que um profeta dos antigos havia ressuscitado.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Ἡρῴδης Ἰωάννην ἐγὼ ἀπεκεφάλισα τίς δέ ἐστιν οὗτος περὶ οὗ ἀκούω τοιαῦτα καὶ ἐζήτει ἰδεῖν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Eipen de ho Hērōdēs Iōannēn egō apekephalisa tis de estin houtos peri hou akouō toiauta kai ezētei idein auton
verses.literal: I beheaded John - Herod said but who is this man I hear such things about And he kept trying to see Jesus
verses.literalPt: E disse Herodes: A João mandei eu degolar; quem é, pois, este de quem ouço dizer tais coisas? E procurava vê-lo.

verses.original: Καὶ ὑποστρέψαντες οἱ ἀπόστολοι διηγήσαντο αὐτῷ ὅσα ἐποίησαν Καὶ παραλαβὼν αὐτοὺς ὑπεχώρησεν κατ’ ἰδίαν εἰς πόλιν καλουμένην Βηθσαϊδά
verses.transliteration: Kai hypostrepsantes hoi apostoloi diēgēsanto autō hosa epoiēsan Kai paralabōn autous hypechōrēsen kat’ idian eis polin kaloumenēn Bēthsaida
verses.literal: Then the apostles returned and reported to Jesus all that they had done Taking them away privately He withdrew to a town called Bethsaida
verses.literalPt: E, regressando os apóstolos, contaram-lhe tudo o que tinham feito. E, tomando-os consigo, retirou-se para um lugar deserto de uma cidade chamada Betsaida.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ὄχλοι γνόντες ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ καὶ ἀποδεξάμενος αὐτοὺς ἐλάλει αὐτοῖς περὶ τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τοὺς χρείαν ἔχοντας θεραπείας ἰᾶτο
verses.transliteration: hoi de ochloi gnontes ēkolouthēsan autō kai apodexamenos autous elalei autois peri tēs basileias tou Theou kai tous chreian echontas therapeias iato
verses.literal: But the crowds found out and followed Him He welcomed them and spoke to them about the kingdom of God and He healed those who needed healing
verses.literalPt: E, sabendo-o a multidão, o seguiu; e ele os recebeu, e falava-lhes do reino de Deus, e sarava os que necessitavam de cura.

verses.original: Ἡ δὲ ἡμέρα ἤρξατο κλίνειν προσελθόντες δὲ οἱ δώδεκα εἶπαν αὐτῷ Ἀπόλυσον τὸν ὄχλον ἵνα πορευθέντες εἰς τὰς κύκλῳ κώμας καὶ ἀγροὺς καταλύσωσιν καὶ εὕρωσιν ἐπισιτισμόν ὅτι ὧδε ἐν ἐρήμῳ τόπῳ ἐσμέν
verses.transliteration: Hē de hēmera ērxato klinein proselthontes de hoi dōdeka eipan autō Apolyson ton ochlon hina poreuthentes eis tas kyklō kōmas kai agrous katalysōsin kai heurōsin episitismon hoti hōde en erēmō topō esmen
verses.literal: As the day neared its end the Twelve came to Jesus and said Dismiss the crowd so they can go to the surrounding villages and countryside for lodging and provisions For we are in a desolate place here
verses.literalPt: E já o dia começava a declinar; então, chegando-se a ele os doze, disseram-lhe: Despede a multidão, para que, indo aos lugares e aldeias em redor, se agasalhem, e achem que comer; porque aqui estamos em lugar deserto.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς Δότε αὐτοῖς φαγεῖν ὑμεῖς Οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Οὐκ εἰσὶν ἡμῖν πλεῖον ἢ ἄρτοι πέντε καὶ ἰχθύες δύο εἰ μήτι πορευθέντες ἡμεῖς ἀγοράσωμεν εἰς πάντα τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον βρώματα
verses.transliteration: Eipen de pros autous Dote autois phagein hymeis Hoi de eipan Ouk eisin hēmin pleion ē artoi pente kai ichthyes dyo ei mēti poreuthentes hēmeis agorasōmen eis panta ton laon touton brōmata
verses.literal: But Jesus told them You give them something to eat We have only five loaves of bread and two fish - they answered unless . . . we go and buy food for all these people
verses.literalPt: Mas ele lhes disse: Dai-lhes vós de comer. E eles disseram: Não temos senão cinco pães e dois peixes, salvo se nós próprios formos comprar comida para todo este povo.

verses.original: ἦσαν γὰρ ὡσεὶ ἄνδρες πεντακισχίλιοι Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ Κατακλίνατε αὐτοὺς κλισίας ὡσεὶ ἀνὰ πεντήκοντα
verses.transliteration: ēsan gar hōsei andres pentakischilioi Eipen de pros tous mathētas autou Kataklinate autous klisias hōsei ana pentēkonta
verses.literal: ( There were about five thousand men He told . . . His disciples Have them sit down . . . in groups of about fifty each
verses.literalPt: Porquanto estavam ali quase cinco mil homens. Disse, então, aos seus discípulos: Fazei-os assentar, em ranchos de cinqüenta em cinqüenta.

verses.original: καὶ ἐποίησαν οὕτως καὶ κατέκλιναν ἅπαντας
verses.transliteration: kai epoiēsan houtōs kai kateklinan hapantas
verses.literal: They did so and everyone was seated
verses.literalPt: E assim o fizeram, fazendo-os assentar a todos.

verses.original: Λαβὼν δὲ τοὺς πέντε ἄρτους καὶ τοὺς δύο ἰχθύας ἀναβλέψας εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εὐλόγησεν αὐτοὺς καὶ κατέκλασεν καὶ ἐδίδου τοῖς μαθηταῖς παραθεῖναι τῷ ὄχλῳ
verses.transliteration: Labōn de tous pente artous kai tous dyo ichthyas anablepsas eis ton ouranon eulogēsen autous kai kateklasen kai edidou tois mathētais paratheinai tō ochlō
verses.literal: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven Jesus spoke a blessing and broke them Then He gave them to the disciples to set before the people
verses.literalPt: E, tomando os cinco pães e os dois peixes, e olhando para o céu, abençoou-os, e partiu-os, e deu-os aos seus discípulos para os porem diante da multidão.

verses.original: Καὶ ἔφαγον καὶ ἐχορτάσθησαν πάντες καὶ ἤρθη τὸ περισσεῦσαν αὐτοῖς κλασμάτων κόφινοι δώδεκα
verses.transliteration: Kai ephagon kai echortasthēsan pantes kai ērthē to perisseusan autois klasmatōn kophinoi dōdeka
verses.literal: They all ate and were satisfied and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over
verses.literalPt: E comeram todos, e saciaram-se; e levantaram, do que lhes sobejou, doze alcofas de pedaços.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ εἶναι αὐτὸν προσευχόμενον κατὰ μόνας συνῆσαν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταί καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτοὺς λέγων Τίνα με οἱ ὄχλοι λέγουσιν εἶναι
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto en tō einai auton proseuchomenon kata monas synēsan autō hoi mathētai kai epērōtēsen autous legōn Tina me hoi ochloi legousin einai
verses.literal: One day as Jesus was praying in private and the disciples were with Him He questioned them Who do the crowds say I am
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, estando ele só, orando, estavam com ele os discípulos; e perguntou-lhes, dizendo: Quem diz a multidão que eu sou?

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ ἀποκριθέντες εἶπαν Ἰωάννην τὸν Βαπτιστήν ἄλλοι δὲ Ἠλίαν ἄλλοι δὲ ὅτι προφήτης τις τῶν ἀρχαίων ἀνέστη
verses.transliteration: Hoi de apokrithentes eipan Iōannēn ton Baptistēn alloi de Ēlian alloi de hoti prophētēs tis tōn archaiōn anestē
verses.literal: They replied . . . Some say John the Baptist others say Elijah and still others that a prophet of old has arisen
verses.literalPt: E, respondendo eles, disseram: João o Batista; outros, Elias, e outros que um dos antigos profetas ressuscitou.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς Ὑμεῖς δὲ τίνα με λέγετε εἶναι Πέτρος δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Τὸν Χριστὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Eipen de autois Hymeis de tina me legete einai Petros de apokritheis eipen Ton Christon tou Theou
verses.literal: But what about you Jesus asked Who do you say I am Peter answered . . . The Christ of God
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes: E vós, quem dizeis que eu sou? E, respondendo Pedro, disse: O Cristo de Deus.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἐπιτιμήσας αὐτοῖς παρήγγειλεν μηδενὶ λέγειν τοῦτο
verses.transliteration: Ho de epitimēsas autois parēngeilen mēdeni legein touto
verses.literal: Jesus strictly warned . . . them not to tell this to anyone
verses.literalPt: E, admoestando-os, mandou que a ninguém referissem isso,

verses.original: εἰπὼν ὅτι Δεῖ τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου πολλὰ παθεῖν καὶ ἀποδοκιμασθῆναι ἀπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ ἀρχιερέων καὶ γραμματέων καὶ ἀποκτανθῆναι καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἐγερθῆναι
verses.transliteration: eipōn hoti Dei ton Huion tou anthrōpou polla pathein kai apodokimasthēnai apo tōn presbyterōn kai archiereōn kai grammateōn kai apoktanthēnai kai tē tritē hēmera egerthēnai
verses.literal: The Son of Man must suffer many things He said - He must be rejected by the elders chief priests and scribes and He must be killed and on the third day be raised to life
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: É necessário que o Filho do homem padeça muitas coisas, e seja rejeitado dos anciãos e dos escribas, e seja morto, e ressuscite ao terceiro dia.

verses.original: Ἔλεγεν δὲ πρὸς πάντας Εἴ τις θέλει ὀπίσω μου ἔρχεσθαι ἀρνησάσθω ἑαυτὸν καὶ ἀράτω τὸν σταυρὸν αὐτοῦ καθ’ ἡμέραν καὶ ἀκολουθείτω μοι
verses.transliteration: Elegen de pros pantas Ei tis thelei opisō mou erchesthai arnēsasthō heauton kai aratō ton stauron autou kath’ hēmeran kai akoloutheitō moi
verses.literal: Then Jesus said to all of them If anyone wants to come after Me he must deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow Me
verses.literalPt: E dizia a todos: Se alguém quer vir após mim, negue-se a si mesmo, e tome cada dia a sua cruz, e siga-me.

verses.original: ὃς γὰρ ἂν θέλῃ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ σῶσαι ἀπολέσει αὐτήν ὃς δ’ ἂν ἀπολέσῃ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ οὗτος σώσει αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: hos gar an thelē tēn psychēn autou sōsai apolesei autēn hos d’ an apolesē tēn psychēn autou heneken emou houtos sōsei autēn
verses.literal: For whoever . . . wants to save his life will lose it but whoever . . . loses his life for My sake . . . will save it
verses.literalPt: Porque, qualquer que quiser salvar a sua vida, perdê-la-á; mas qualquer que, por amor de mim, perder a sua vida, a salvará.

verses.original: Τί γὰρ ὠφελεῖται ἄνθρωπος κερδήσας τὸν κόσμον ὅλον ἑαυτὸν δὲ ἀπολέσας ἢ ζημιωθείς
verses.transliteration: Ti gar ōpheleitai anthrōpos kerdēsas ton kosmon holon heauton de apolesas ē zēmiōtheis
verses.literal: What does it profit a man to gain the whole world yet lose or forfeit his very self
verses.literalPt: Porque, que aproveita ao homem granjear o mundo todo, perdendo-se ou prejudicando-se a si mesmo?

verses.original: ὃς γὰρ ἂν ἐπαισχυνθῇ με καὶ τοὺς ἐμοὺς λόγους τοῦτον ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐπαισχυνθήσεται ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐν τῇ δόξῃ αὐτοῦ καὶ τοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ τῶν ἁγίων ἀγγέλων
verses.transliteration: hos gar an epaischynthē me kai tous emous logous touton ho Huios tou anthrōpou epaischynthēsetai hotan elthē en tē doxē autou kai tou Patros kai tōn hagiōn angelōn
verses.literal: If anyone . . . is ashamed of Me and My words the Son of Man will be ashamed of him when He comes in His glory and in the glory of the Father and of the holy angels
verses.literalPt: Porque, qualquer que de mim e das minhas palavras se envergonhar, dele se envergonhará o Filho do homem, quando vier na sua glória, e na do Pai e dos santos anjos.

verses.original: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ἀληθῶς εἰσίν τινες τῶν αὐτοῦ ἑστηκότων οἳ οὐ μὴ γεύσωνται θανάτου ἕως ἂν ἴδωσιν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: legō de hymin alēthōs eisin tines tōn autou hestēkotōn hoi ou mē geusōntai thanatou heōs an idōsin tēn basileian tou Theou
verses.literal: But I tell you truly some who are standing here will not taste death before . . . they see the kingdom of God
verses.literalPt: E em verdade vos digo que, dos que aqui estão, alguns há que não provarão a morte até que vejam o reino de Deus.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ μετὰ τοὺς λόγους τούτους ὡσεὶ ἡμέραι ὀκτὼ καὶ παραλαβὼν Πέτρον καὶ Ἰωάννην καὶ Ἰάκωβον ἀνέβη εἰς τὸ ὄρος προσεύξασθαι
verses.transliteration: Egeneto de meta tous logous toutous hōsei hēmerai oktō kai paralabōn Petron kai Iōannēn kai Iakōbon anebē eis to oros proseuxasthai
verses.literal: About eight days after Jesus had said these things He took with Him Peter John and James and went up on a mountain to pray
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, quase oito dias depois destas palavras, tomou consigo a Pedro, a João e a Tiago, e subiu ao monte a orar.

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ προσεύχεσθαι αὐτὸν τὸ εἶδος τοῦ προσώπου αὐτοῦ ἕτερον καὶ ὁ ἱματισμὸς αὐτοῦ λευκὸς ἐξαστράπτων
verses.transliteration: kai egeneto en tō proseuchesthai auton to eidos tou prosōpou autou heteron kai ho himatismos autou leukos exastraptōn
verses.literal: And as . . . He was praying the appearance of His face changed and His clothes became radiantly white
verses.literalPt: E, estando ele orando, transfigurou-se a aparência do seu rosto, e a sua roupa ficou branca e mui resplandecente.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνδρες δύο συνελάλουν αὐτῷ οἵτινες ἦσαν Μωϋσῆς καὶ Ἠλίας
verses.transliteration: kai idou andres dyo synelaloun autō hoitines ēsan Mōusēs kai Ēlias
verses.literal: Suddenly two men - Moses and Elijah began talking with Jesus
verses.literalPt: E eis que estavam falando com ele dois homens, que eram Moisés e Elias,

verses.original: οἳ ὀφθέντες ἐν δόξῃ ἔλεγον τὴν ἔξοδον αὐτοῦ ἣν ἤμελλεν πληροῦν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ
verses.transliteration: hoi ophthentes en doxē elegon tēn exodon autou hēn ēmellen plēroun en Ierousalēm
verses.literal: They appeared in glory and spoke about His departure which He was about to accomplish at Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Os quais apareceram com glória, e falavam da sua morte, a qual havia de cumprir-se em Jerusalém.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Πέτρος καὶ οἱ σὺν αὐτῷ ἦσαν βεβαρημένοι ὕπνῳ διαγρηγορήσαντες δὲ εἶδον τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς δύο ἄνδρας τοὺς συνεστῶτας αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Ho de Petros kai hoi syn autō ēsan bebarēmenoi hypnō diagrēgorēsantes de eidon tēn doxan autou kai tous dyo andras tous synestōtas autō
verses.literal: Meanwhile Peter and his companions . . . . . . were overcome by sleep but when they awoke they saw Jesus’ glory and the two men standing with Him
verses.literalPt: E Pedro e os que estavam com ele estavam carregados de sono; e, quando despertaram, viram a sua glória e aqueles dois homens que estavam com ele.

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ διαχωρίζεσθαι αὐτοὺς ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ εἶπεν ὁ Πέτρος πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν Ἐπιστάτα καλόν ἐστιν ἡμᾶς ὧδε εἶναι καὶ ποιήσωμεν σκηνὰς τρεῖς μίαν σοὶ καὶ μίαν Μωϋσεῖ καὶ μίαν Ἠλίᾳ μὴ εἰδὼς ὃ λέγει
verses.transliteration: kai egeneto en tō diachōrizesthai autous ap’ autou eipen ho Petros pros ton Iēsoun Epistata kalon estin hēmas hōde einai kai poiēsōmen skēnas treis mian soi kai mian Mōusei kai mian Ēlia mē eidōs ho legei
verses.literal: As . . . . . . Moses and Elijah were leaving . . . . . . Peter said to Jesus Master it is good for us to be here Let us put up three shelters one for You one for Moses and one for Elijah ( He did not know what he was saying
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, quando aqueles se apartaram dele, disse Pedro a Jesus: Mestre, bom é que nós estejamos aqui, e façamos três tendas: uma para ti, uma para Moisés, e uma para Elias, não sabendo o que dizia.

verses.original: Ταῦτα δὲ αὐτοῦ λέγοντος ἐγένετο νεφέλη καὶ ἐπεσκίαζεν αὐτούς ἐφοβήθησαν δὲ ἐν τῷ εἰσελθεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν νεφέλην
verses.transliteration: Tauta de autou legontos egeneto nephelē kai epeskiazen autous ephobēthēsan de en tō eiselthein autous eis tēn nephelēn
verses.literal: While Peter was speaking . . . a cloud appeared and enveloped them and they were afraid as they entered . . . the cloud
verses.literalPt: E, dizendo ele isto, veio uma nuvem que os cobriu com a sua sombra; e, entrando eles na nuvem, temeram.

verses.original: καὶ φωνὴ ἐγένετο ἐκ τῆς νεφέλης λέγουσα Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Υἱός μου ὁ ἐκλελεγμένος αὐτοῦ ἀκούετε
verses.transliteration: kai phōnē egeneto ek tēs nephelēs legousa Houtos estin ho Huios mou ho eklelegmenos autou akouete
verses.literal: And a voice came from the cloud saying This is My Son whom I have chosen Listen to Him
verses.literalPt: E saiu da nuvem uma voz que dizia: Este é o meu amado Filho; a ele ouvi.

verses.original: καὶ ἐν τῷ γενέσθαι τὴν φωνὴν εὑρέθη Ἰησοῦς μόνος καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐσίγησαν καὶ οὐδενὶ ἀπήγγειλαν ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις οὐδὲν ὧν ἑώρακαν
verses.transliteration: kai en tō genesthai tēn phōnēn heurethē Iēsous monos kai autoi esigēsan kai oudeni apēngeilan en ekeinais tais hēmerais ouden hōn heōrakan
verses.literal: After . . . the voice had spoken only Jesus was present with them The disciples kept this to themselves and in those days they did not tell anyone . . . . . . what they had seen
verses.literalPt: E, tendo soado aquela voz, Jesus foi achado só; e eles calaram-se, e por aqueles dias não contaram a ninguém nada do que tinham visto.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ τῇ ἑξῆς ἡμέρᾳ κατελθόντων αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους συνήντησεν αὐτῷ ὄχλος πολύς
verses.transliteration: Egeneto de tē hexēs hēmera katelthontōn autōn apo tou orous synēntēsen autō ochlos polys
verses.literal: The next day when they came down from the mountain Jesus was met by a large crowd
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu, no dia seguinte, que, descendo eles do monte, lhes saiu ao encontro uma grande multidão;

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄχλου ἐβόησεν λέγων Διδάσκαλε δέομαί σου ἐπιβλέψαι ἐπὶ τὸν υἱόν μου ὅτι μονογενής μοί ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: kai idou anēr apo tou ochlou eboēsen legōn Didaskale deomai sou epiblepsai epi ton huion mou hoti monogenēs moi estin
verses.literal: Suddenly . . . a man in the crowd cried out . . . Teacher I beg You to look at my son for he is my only child
verses.literalPt: E eis que um homem da multidão clamou, dizendo: Mestre, peço-te que olhes para meu filho, porque é o único que eu tenho.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ πνεῦμα λαμβάνει αὐτόν καὶ ἐξαίφνης κράζει καὶ σπαράσσει αὐτὸν μετὰ ἀφροῦ καὶ μόγις ἀποχωρεῖ ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ συντρῖβον αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai idou pneuma lambanei auton kai exaiphnēs krazei kai sparassei auton meta aphrou kai mogis apochōrei ap’ autou syntribon auton
verses.literal: A spirit keeps seizing him and he screams abruptly It throws him into convulsions . . . so that he foams at the mouth It keeps mauling him and rarely departs from him
verses.literalPt: Eis que um espírito o toma e de repente clama, e o despedaça até espumar; e só o larga depois de o ter quebrantado.

verses.original: καὶ ἐδεήθην τῶν μαθητῶν σου ἵνα ἐκβάλωσιν αὐτό καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνήθησαν
verses.transliteration: kai edeēthēn tōn mathētōn sou hina ekbalōsin auto kai ouk ēdynēthēsan
verses.literal: I begged Your disciples to drive it out . . . but they were unable
verses.literalPt: E roguei aos teus discípulos que o expulsassem, e não puderam.

verses.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Ὦ γενεὰ ἄπιστος καὶ διεστραμμένη ἕως πότε ἔσομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ ἀνέξομαι ὑμῶν προσάγαγε ὧδε τὸν υἱόν σου
verses.transliteration: Apokritheis de ho Iēsous eipen Ō genea apistos kai diestrammenē heōs pote esomai pros hymas kai anexomai hymōn prosagage hōde ton huion sou
verses.literal: O unbelieving and perverse generation - Jesus replied . . . How long . . . must I remain with you and put up with you Bring your son here
verses.literalPt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse: Ó geração incrédula e perversa! até quando estarei ainda convosco e vos sofrerei? Traze-me aqui o teu filho.

verses.original: Ἔτι δὲ προσερχομένου αὐτοῦ ἔρρηξεν αὐτὸν τὸ δαιμόνιον καὶ συνεσπάραξεν ἐπετίμησεν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῷ πνεύματι τῷ ἀκαθάρτῳ καὶ ἰάσατο τὸν παῖδα καὶ ἀπέδωκεν αὐτὸν τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Eti de proserchomenou autou errēxen auton to daimonion kai synesparaxen epetimēsen de ho Iēsous tō pneumati tō akathartō kai iasato ton paida kai apedōken auton tō patri autou
verses.literal: Even while the boy was approaching the demon slammed him to the ground . . . in a convulsion But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit healed the boy and gave him back . . . to his father
verses.literalPt: E, quando vinha chegando, o demônio o derrubou e convulsionou; porém, Jesus repreendeu o espírito imundo, e curou o menino, e o entregou a seu pai.

verses.original: Ἐξεπλήσσοντο δὲ πάντες ἐπὶ τῇ μεγαλειότητι τοῦ Θεοῦ Πάντων δὲ θαυμαζόντων ἐπὶ πᾶσιν οἷς ἐποίει εἶπεν πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Exeplēssonto de pantes epi tē megaleiotēti tou Theou Pantōn de thaumazontōn epi pasin hois epoiei eipen pros tous mathētas autou
verses.literal: And they were all astonished at the greatness of God While everyone was marveling at all that Jesus was doing He said to His disciples
verses.literalPt: E todos pasmavam da majestade de Deus. E, maravilhando-se todos de todas as coisas que Jesus fazia, disse aos seus discípulos:

verses.original: Θέσθε ὑμεῖς εἰς τὰ ὦτα ὑμῶν τοὺς λόγους τούτους ὁ γὰρ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου μέλλει παραδίδοσθαι εἰς χεῖρας ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: Thesthe hymeis eis ta ōta hymōn tous logous toutous ho gar Huios tou anthrōpou mellei paradidosthai eis cheiras anthrōpōn
verses.literal: Let these words sink into your ears The Son of Man is about to be delivered into the hands of men
verses.literalPt: Ponde vós estas palavras em vossos ouvidos, porque o Filho do homem será entregue nas mãos dos homens.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ἠγνόουν τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο καὶ ἦν παρακεκαλυμμένον ἀπ’ αὐτῶν ἵνα μὴ αἴσθωνται αὐτό καὶ ἐφοβοῦντο ἐρωτῆσαι αὐτὸν περὶ τοῦ ῥήματος τούτου
verses.transliteration: hoi de ēgnooun to rhēma touto kai ēn parakekalymmenon ap’ autōn hina mē aisthōntai auto kai ephobounto erōtēsai auton peri tou rhēmatos toutou
verses.literal: But they did not understand this statement It was veiled from them so that they could not comprehend it and they were afraid to ask Him about it
verses.literalPt: Mas eles não entendiam esta palavra, que lhes era encoberta, para que a não compreendessem; e temiam interrogá-lo acerca desta palavra.

verses.original: Εἰσῆλθεν δὲ διαλογισμὸς ἐν αὐτοῖς τὸ τίς ἂν εἴη μείζων αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Eisēlthen de dialogismos en autois to tis an eiē meizōn autōn
verses.literal: Then an argument started among the disciples as to which . . . of them would be the greatest
verses.literalPt: E suscitou-se entre eles uma discussão sobre qual deles seria o maior.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἰδὼς τὸν διαλογισμὸν τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν ἐπιλαβόμενος παιδίον ἔστησεν αὐτὸ παρ’ ἑαυτῷ
verses.transliteration: ho de Iēsous eidōs ton dialogismon tēs kardias autōn epilabomenos paidion estēsen auto par’ heautō
verses.literal: But Jesus knowing the thoughts of their hearts had . . . a little child stand beside Him
verses.literalPt: Mas Jesus, vendo o pensamento de seus corações, tomou um menino, pô-lo junto a si,

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ὃς ἐὰν δέξηται τοῦτο τὸ παιδίον ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου ἐμὲ δέχεται καὶ ὃς ἂν ἐμὲ δέξηται δέχεται τὸν ἀποστείλαντά με ὁ γὰρ μικρότερος ἐν πᾶσιν ὑμῖν ὑπάρχων οὗτός ἐστιν μέγας
verses.transliteration: kai eipen autois Hos ean dexētai touto to paidion epi tō onomati mou eme dechetai kai hos an eme dexētai dechetai ton aposteilanta me ho gar mikroteros en pasin hymin hyparchōn houtos estin megas
verses.literal: And He said to them Whoever . . . welcomes this little child in My name welcomes Me and whoever . . . welcomes Me welcomes the One who sent Me For whoever is the least among all of you he is the greatest
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes: Qualquer que receber este menino em meu nome, recebe-me a mim; e qualquer que me receber a mim, recebe o que me enviou; porque aquele que entre vós todos for o menor, esse mesmo é grande.

verses.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰωάννης εἶπεν Ἐπιστάτα εἴδομέν τινα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἐκβάλλοντα δαιμόνια καὶ ἐκωλύομεν αὐτὸν ὅτι οὐκ ἀκολουθεῖ μεθ’ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Apokritheis de ho Iōannēs eipen Epistata eidomen tina en tō onomati sou ekballonta daimonia kai ekōlyomen auton hoti ouk akolouthei meth’ hēmōn
verses.literal: Master - said . . . John we saw someone driving out demons in Your name and we tried to stop him because . . . he does not accompany . . . us
verses.literalPt: E, respondendo João, disse: Mestre, vimos um que em teu nome expulsava os demônios, e lho proibimos, porque não te segue conosco.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Μὴ κωλύετε ὃς γὰρ οὐκ ἔστιν καθ’ ὑμῶν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Eipen de pros auton ho Iēsous Mē kōlyete hos gar ouk estin kath’ hymōn hyper hymōn estin
verses.literal: Do not stop him - Jesus replied - for whoever is not against you is for you
verses.literalPt: E Jesus lhes disse: Não o proibais, porque quem não é contra nós é por nós.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ συμπληροῦσθαι τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ἀναλήμψεως αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτὸς τὸ πρόσωπον ἐστήρισεν τοῦ πορεύεσθαι εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ
verses.transliteration: Egeneto de en tō symplērousthai tas hēmeras tēs analēmpseōs autou kai autos to prosōpon estērisen tou poreuesthai eis Ierousalēm
verses.literal: As the day of His ascension approached Jesus resolutely set out . . . . . . . . . . . . for Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, completando-se os dias para a sua assunção, manifestou o firme propósito de ir a Jerusalém.

verses.original: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ἀγγέλους πρὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ καὶ πορευθέντες εἰσῆλθον εἰς κώμην Σαμαριτῶν ὡς ἑτοιμάσαι αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai apesteilen angelous pro prosōpou autou kai poreuthentes eisēlthon eis kōmēn Samaritōn hōs hetoimasai autō
verses.literal: He sent messengers on ahead . . . . . . who went . . . into a village of the Samaritans to make arrangements for Him
verses.literalPt: E mandou mensageiros adiante de si; e, indo eles, entraram numa aldeia de samaritanos, para lhe prepararem pousada,

verses.original: καὶ οὐκ ἐδέξαντο αὐτόν ὅτι τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἦν πορευόμενον εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ
verses.transliteration: kai ouk edexanto auton hoti to prosōpon autou ēn poreuomenon eis Ierousalēm
verses.literal: But the people there refused to welcome Him because He . . . . . . was heading for Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Mas não o receberam, porque o seu aspecto era como de quem ia a Jerusalém.

verses.original: Ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ Ἰάκωβος καὶ Ἰωάννης εἶπαν Κύριε θέλεις εἴπωμεν πῦρ καταβῆναι ἀπὸ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἀναλῶσαι αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Idontes de hoi mathētai Iakōbos kai Iōannēs eipan Kyrie theleis eipōmen pyr katabēnai apo tou ouranou kai analōsai autous
verses.literal: When the disciples James and John saw this they asked Lord do You want us to call down fire from heaven to consume them
verses.literalPt: E os seus discípulos, Tiago e João, vendo isto, disseram: Senhor, queres que digamos que desça fogo do céu e os consuma, como Elias também fez?

verses.original: Στραφεὶς δὲ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Strapheis de epetimēsen autois
verses.literal: But Jesus turned and rebuked them
verses.literalPt: Voltando-se, porém, repreendeu-os, e disse: Vós não sabeis de que espírito sois.

verses.original: καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν εἰς ἑτέραν κώμην
verses.transliteration: kai eporeuthēsan eis heteran kōmēn
verses.literal: And He and His disciples went on to another village
verses.literalPt: Porque o Filho do homem não veio para destruir as almas dos homens, mas para salvá-las. E foram para outra aldeia.

verses.original: Καὶ πορευομένων αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ εἶπέν τις πρὸς αὐτόν Ἀκολουθήσω σοι ὅπου ἐὰν ἀπέρχῃ
verses.transliteration: Kai poreuomenōn autōn en tē hodō eipen tis pros auton Akolouthēsō soi hopou ean aperchē
verses.literal: As they were walking along the road someone said to Jesus I will follow You wherever . . . You go
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, indo eles pelo caminho, lhe disse um: Senhor, seguir-te-ei para onde quer que fores.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Αἱ ἀλώπεκες φωλεοὺς ἔχουσιν καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατασκηνώσεις ὁ δὲ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου οὐκ ἔχει ποῦ τὴν κεφαλὴν κλίνῃ
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen autō ho Iēsous Hai alōpekes phōleous echousin kai ta peteina tou ouranou kataskēnōseis ho de Huios tou anthrōpou ouk echei pou tēn kephalēn klinē
verses.literal: Jesus replied - Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests but the Son of Man has no place . . . to lay His head
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhe Jesus: As raposas têm covis, e as aves do céu, ninhos, mas o Filho do homem não tem onde reclinar a cabeça.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς ἕτερον Ἀκολούθει μοι ὁ Δὲ εἶπεν Κύριε Ἐπίτρεψόν μοι πρῶτον ἀπελθόντι θάψαι τὸν πατέρα μου
verses.transliteration: Eipen de pros heteron Akolouthei moi ho De eipen Kyrie Epitrepson moi prōton apelthonti thapsai ton patera mou
verses.literal: Then He said to another man Follow Me - The man replied Lord first let me go and bury my father
verses.literalPt: E disse a outro: Segue-me. Mas ele respondeu: SENHOR, deixa que primeiro eu vá a enterrar meu pai.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ Ἄφες τοὺς νεκροὺς θάψαι τοὺς ἑαυτῶν νεκρούς σὺ δὲ ἀπελθὼν διάγγελλε τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Eipen de autō Aphes tous nekrous thapsai tous heautōn nekrous sy de apelthōn diangelle tēn basileian tou Theou
verses.literal: But Jesus told him Let the dead bury their own dead You however go and proclaim the kingdom of God
verses.literalPt: Mas Jesus lhe observou: Deixa aos mortos o enterrar os seus mortos; porém tu vai e anuncia o reino de Deus.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ καὶ ἕτερος Ἀκολουθήσω σοι Κύριε πρῶτον δὲ ἐπίτρεψόν μοι ἀποτάξασθαι τοῖς εἰς τὸν οἶκόν μου
verses.transliteration: Eipen de kai heteros Akolouthēsō soi Kyrie prōton de epitrepson moi apotaxasthai tois eis ton oikon mou
verses.literal: Still another said I will follow You Lord but first let me bid farewell to my family
verses.literalPt: Disse também outro: Senhor, eu te seguirei, mas deixa-me despedir primeiro dos que estão em minha casa.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Οὐδεὶς ἐπιβαλὼν τὴν χεῖρα ἐπ’ ἄροτρον καὶ βλέπων εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω εὔθετός ἐστιν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Eipen de pros auton ho Iēsous Oudeis epibalōn tēn cheira ep’ arotron kai blepōn eis ta opisō euthetos estin tē basileia tou Theou
verses.literal: Then Jesus declared . . . . . . No one who puts his hand to the plow and then looks back is fit for the kingdom of God
verses.literalPt: E Jesus lhe disse: Ninguém, que lança mão do arado e olha para trás, é apto para o reino de Deus.
